name: Image-Based Light Shaft (Dobashi)
definition: A method that displays light shafts with a shadow map using texture-mapping hardware by placing parallel slices in front of the screen to compute light scattering induced by atmospheric particles.
summary: Image-Based Light Shaft (Dobashi) renders volumetric light scattering using parallel slices and hardware-accelerated shadow mapping, distinguishing itself from screen-space artifacts by explicitly modeling volumetric light transport.
